title: Login Issues - Can't Access Account
description: Customer is unable to log in to their account. They've tried resetting their password multiple times but still can't access their account. The error message says 'Invalid credentials'.

title: Payment Failed - Card Declined
description: Customer attempted to pay using Visa ending in 1234 but the payment keeps failing despite sufficient balance in the account.

title: Unable to Download Invoice
description: Customer cannot download their January invoice from the billing section. The download button is unresponsive and shows a loading spinner indefinitely.

title: Incorrect Billing Address on Account
description: Customer's billing address shows a different city. They updated it but it still displays the old address after saving changes.

title: App Crash on Launch - Android 13
description: Customer reports that the mobile app crashes immediately upon opening on Android 13. The issue started after the latest app update.

title: Refund Not Processed After 14 Days
description: Customer requested a refund two weeks ago but has not received the amount back. The refund was approved but the money never arrived.

title: Two-Factor Authentication Not Working
description: Customer is not receiving 2FA verification codes on their registered phone number. The codes never arrive even after multiple retry attempts.

title: Unable to Update Profile Picture
description: Customer tries to upload a new profile picture but consistently receives an 'Upload failed' error message. The file size is well within limits.

title: Subscription Auto-Renewal Toggle Disabled
description: Customer wants to enable auto-renewal for their subscription but the toggle switch is greyed out and unresponsive on the account settings page.

title: Missing Order Confirmation Email
description: Customer placed an order but never received a confirmation email even though the payment was successfully charged to their account.

title: Account Locked After Too Many Login Attempts
description: Customer's account has been locked after multiple failed login attempts. They need their account unlocked and security reviewed.

title: Dark Mode Not Saving Preference
description: Customer switches to dark mode but every time they return to the app the setting resets to light mode. Preference is not being persisted.
